title: DOWNED CARD: BIGGER LABEL, LIME KEY
why: Critic on screen 34 (3 of 5): the small down label is easy to miss and the self-revive prompt should be the lime action. The label goes to the title size and the live key is drawn in the accent.
now: On the downed card the word down is bigger and the self-revive key shows in lime.

edits.replacement: ctx.font=FS(TYPE.title); ctx.fillStyle=UIC.danger; ctx.fillText('DOWN',W/2,_dy-Math.round((_hH-_dpx(FS(TYPE.title)))*0.5));   // v34.40 (cw-downedcard2), critic on screen 34 (P1 'the small down label is easy to miss'): the danger label is the title size (26), the timer stays the one hero

edits.anchor:
ctx.fillText(p.revived?'Bleeding out. Crawl to an open extraction point.':
      '['+keyLabel('KeyF','F')+'] SELF-REVIVE, one per raid',W/2,_rowY);
